

# svchost.exe is all Rust (svchost-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/svchost-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# globals.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/svchost-rust/src/svchost/globals.rs)
# registry.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/svchost-rust/src/svchost/registry.rs)
# rpcsrv.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/svchost-rust/src/svchost/rpcsrv.rs)
# netbios.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/svchost-rust/src/svchost/netbios.rs)
# svchost.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/svchost-rust/src/svchost/svchost.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(svchost_shims OBJECT security.cxx)
target_link_libraries(svchost_shims PRIVATE uuid libadvapi32 librpcrt4 libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(svchost_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(svchost svchost-cargo svchost.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE svchost-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS svchost_shims psdk uuid_sources)
